changes: Retain source multi toggle, checked rows, review sheet, quantity editing, recipe fields, dismissal and focus controls.
Use canonical cloud preview and immutable workspace command envelope; require durable owner-scoped storage before sending.
Only main picker opts in; ingredient/photo/text pickers remain single-select.
Keep original search categories, database badges, sort and filter persistence.
Owner-scoped recovery cannot restore another account snapshot; completed saves only notify the current panel for that owner.
Accept backend-owned meal expansion: diary success IDs must be nonempty unique strings, without assuming one entry per selected row.

integration.cleanup: Callable disposer with ready Promise; snapshot(); applyEntry(entry,quantityLabel); returnFromDetail(); select(row,entry?)
integration.preferences: Local storage retains presentation choices including multi enabled. Selections and search snapshots are transient. Only submitted immutable attempts persist in owner-scoped IndexedDB.

validation: tests/food-multi-ui.test.mjs: mixed sources; draft edit/remount; recipe; preview retry; persistence failure blocks send; unreadable committed reply; identical retry after reload; owner separation; owner change during save; transient cancellation; barcode select; child single-select; CSP/mobile viewport.
Three selected source rows can return four diary IDs; empty, duplicate, and blank ID success responses retain the saved attempt for exact retry.
limitations: Browser test uses stub review/command API; production-domain and Appwrite verification belongs to root integration checks.
